snippet.title: Thieves Guild Master - First Gameplay Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
Run a thieves’ guild in Arathia, a medieval fantasy city of scheming nobles, hardworking people and rival gangs. Recruit thieves, take risky contracts, and expand your shadow empire in this turn-based guild management strategy game.
